description: Rokid Glasses AIUI Agent - a head-down posture break reminder: calibrate your neutral head pitch once (AbsoluteOrientationSensor quaternion), then any continuous stretch drooping more than 25 degrees below neutral is timed; brief lifts under 10 seconds only pause the clock, and at your limit (5/10/20 min) it speaks one gentle reminder to look up - it measures head pitch only, not your spine
name: posture-guard
